name: Jin Kun
current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Shanghai Beite Technology Group (SSE: 603009)
profile: Jin Kun (靳坤) is the founder-chairman and controlling shareholder of Shanghai Beite Technology, an auto-parts maker founded in 2002 and listed in Shanghai in 2014. Beite makes steering-rack and shock-absorber piston rods, auto A/C compressors, precision parts and lightweight aluminium components. Wealth shared with Jin Xiaotang, his concert party in Beite filings.
interesting_fact: Beite's predecessor was Shanghai Beite Metal Products Co.; in 2024 Jin Kun's voting stake passively rose above 30% (triggering a takeover report) only because Beite cancelled shares returned under a performance-compensation agreement.
notes: Low public profile; no personal interviews found. Best route is Beite's board-secretary/IR mailbox (touzizhe@ = 'investor').

name: Lawrence Jones
current_role: None – former founder/CEO of UKFast (left 2019); serving a 15-year prison sentence since Dec 2023
profile: Welsh-born Lawrence Jones co-founded Manchester web-hosting/cloud firm UKFast with wife Gail in 1999 and built it into a major UK hosting provider before stepping down in 2019; UKFast (later ANS) was sold to Inflexion. In December 2023 he was convicted of two rapes and a sexual assault and jailed for 15 years.
interesting_fact: UKFast was founded in September 1999 by Lawrence and Gail Jones and grew into one of the UK's best-known independent hosting/cloud providers.
notes: DO NOT approach: convicted in 2023 of rape and sexual assault, jailed 15 years (https://www.uktech.news/tech-hubs/north-west/manchester/ukfast-founder-sentenced-15-years-prison-20231204). Wealth listing shared with ex-wife Gail Jones. No deep-cut fact recorded deliberately.

name: Peng Yijie
current_role: Senior Vice President and Chief Sustainability Officer, Ant Group (as of latest 2025 sources; 2026 status unconfirmed)
profile: Peng Yijie (Sabrina Peng, 彭翼捷) joined Alibaba in May 2000, was a VP overseeing its B2B marketplaces (2008-12) and founded the AliExpress product, then built Alipay's international business from 2012. Later Ant's CMO and head of social good/green development, she became Ant Group's first Chief Sustainability Officer in May 2022. Her wealth stems from Alibaba/Ant equity.
interesting_fact: She founded AliExpress as a product inside Alibaba, and when Alibaba's 27 partners were named in 2014 she was the youngest of them.
deep_cut_fact: Her Alibaba employee number was 152 – she joined in May 2000, when the company was barely a year old (AliExpress founding per https://fintechfestival.sg/speakers-archive-2023/1622-sabrina-yijie-peng).
notes: Speaks publicly on carbon neutrality / ESG (Ant's data centres are main Scope 3 source) – good fit for energy/data-centre angle. Reach via Ant Group media relations. Not on the FY2025 Alibaba partner list per reports.

name: Hou Weigui
current_role: Chairman, ZTE Weixiantong (中兴维先通) Equipment Co.; founder and former chairman of ZTE (stepped down 2016)
profile: Hou Weigui (侯为贵), born c.1942, was a technician at Aerospace Factory 691 before being sent to Shenzhen in 1985 to set up Zhongxing Semiconductor, the seed of ZTE. He ran ZTE as GM through its 1997 A-share listing and was chairman 2004-2016, building it into a global telecom-equipment maker. Still chairs ZTE's controlling-shareholder side vehicle Zhongxing Weixiantong.
interesting_fact: ZTE's very first customer was the town of Taoyuan in Wujiang county, Suzhou, which paid for telephone installations itself and handed the switching equipment to the telecom bureau.
deep_cut_fact: Since 2005 Hou has led ZTE's long-running support programme for surviving Yunnan veterans of the War of Resistance against Japan; on a 1981 US training trip he was struck by the gap in living standards, which shaped his market-first thinking.
notes: Now in his 80s and largely retired from ZTE; gave a long interview to The Paper in 2023. ZTE IR is a corporate channel, not his personal office.

name: Zhang Suyang
current_role: Founding Partner, Volcanics Venture (火山石投资), Shanghai
profile: Zhang Suyang (章苏阳) is one of China's first-generation venture capitalists: he joined IDG Capital around 1994 and led its early bets on Ctrip (1999, ~34x) and Home Inns (2003, ~57x). After retiring from IDG he founded Volcanics Venture in 2016, a boutique early-stage firm (>RMB3bn dual-currency) backing AI, robotics (Geek+, Fourier), chips and healthcare.
interesting_fact: He has said IDG was ready to invest about US$3m in Alibaba but Jack Ma took Goldman Sachs and SoftBank money instead – one of his acknowledged regrets; the eBay-China (EachNet) deal was decided in ~20 hours and signed in a teahouse.
deep_cut_fact: An electronics-engineering graduate (Shanghai University, 1982), he was deputy director of the Ministry of Posts' Shanghai 520 factory and worked at Shanghai Bell before VC; he loves live music (goes whenever a good band comes to town) and was once a keen photographer.
notes: Gives occasional long-form interviews (ChinaVenture, July 2026) on China VC history and AI cycles; good podcast fit (robotics, AI). Approach via Volcanics Venture; no published email found. Background details also in https://pitchhub.36kr.com/organization/1678213531595779.

name: Tang Zhuolin
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Guangdong Dongfang Precision Science & Technology (SZSE: 002611), Foshan
profile: Tang Zhuolin (唐灼林, 'Victor Tang', b.1963) founded Dongfang Precision in Foshan in 1996, growing it from a workshop making printing/packaging machinery into a leading corrugated-box equipment maker, listed in 2011. He expanded via acquisitions (Italy's Fosber 2014, Baisheng marine engines, EDF, Tiruna, Agnati) and in 2025 sold the Fosber overseas corrugated-line business for ~€817m, pivoting to high-end smart equipment, outboard power and AI+robotics.
interesting_fact: The Fosber corrugated-line business he bought into in 2014 was sold in 2025 for a final consideration of about €817m, funding a pivot to robotics and marine power.
deep_cut_fact: Before running the company he also served as its general manager and chief engineer; Dongfang Precision began in agricultural-product packaging printing before moving into corrugated-carton equipment.
notes: Co-controller with brother Tang Zhuomian per 2011 IPO docs. Manufacturing/robotics pivot is a podcast angle.

name: Ding Yuhua
current_role: Deceased (died 13 June 2018); was executive chairman of Triangle Tyre / Triangle Group, Weihai
profile: Ding Yuhua (丁玉华) led Weihai-based Triangle Group/Triangle Tyre for about 28 years, growing it from a provincial tyre factory into one of the world's larger full-line tyre makers, and was a deputy to four National People's Congresses. He died unexpectedly on 13 June 2018; his son Ding Mu succeeded him as chairman.
notes: Deceased 2018 (sources: https://tyrepress.com/2018/06/triangle-mourns-chairman-ding-yuhua ; https://www.moderntiredealer.com/articles/13162-triangle-tyre-s-chairman-ding-dies-at-69). Successor/heir: Ding Mu, chairman of Triangle Tyre (601163); company IR email jqgc@triangle.com.cn per cninfo.

name: Michael Cornish
current_role: Former chairman of Linpac (Louth, Lincolnshire packaging group); no current executive role found
profile: Michael (John) Cornish, b. c.1953, is the son of Evan Cornish, who founded Lincolnshire Packaging Co (later Linpac) in Louth in 1959. Michael became chairman in 1992 and led the family-controlled plastics/packaging, materials-handling and waste-container group; the family's stake was realised in the ~£860m sale to Montagu Private Equity in 2003. He was on Linpac Group's board until 2009.
interesting_fact: Linpac grew from a small Louth packaging business founded in 1959 into a multinational plastics-packaging group; the family sale netted Michael Cornish an estimated £203m.
deep_cut_fact: He chaired the Michael Cornish Charitable Trust (registered 2005), a Lincolnshire grant-maker supporting children's and local charities; it was wound down and removed from the register in January 2026.
notes: Very private; no public profile, website or social accounts found. Linpac board dates (2003-2009) per https://webb-site.com/dbpub/offsum.asp?p=62993. Alive status not confirmed by any recent source.

name: Lin Hao
current_role: Chairman, controlling shareholder and actual controller, Beijing VRV Software Corp. (北信源, SZSE: 300352; trading as 'ST信源' in 2026)
profile: Lin Hao (林皓) founded Beijing VRV Software in 1996 and took it public on ChiNext in 2012. VRV began with the 'VRV Virus Killer' antivirus, then became China's long-time market leader in endpoint/intranet security management, and since 2013 has built Linkdood (信源密信), a secure messaging platform used by government, defence units and SOEs. In 2026 he is pushing overseas expansion via Malaysia and AI+secure communications.
interesting_fact: He says he proposed the concept of 'intranet security' (内网安全) in 2003, about a decade before the industry caught on, and that he 'lays out one big thing every ten years'.
deep_cut_fact: VRV's first product, 'VRV病毒克星' (VRV Virus Killer), made it one of China's first-generation antivirus companies alongside Jiangmin; Lin describes his management style as a 'nail-man' (钉子人) spirit of digging deep in one field.
notes: Stock is under special treatment ('ST信源') in 2026 – avoid raising this. Gives media interviews on cybersecurity/secure comms (2023 finet, 2026 科创中国).

name: Fei Gongquan
current_role: Actual controller and director, Haitian Water Group (海天水务/海天股份, SSE: 603759), Chengdu; stepped down as chairman (chairman now Fei Junjie)
profile: Fei Gongquan (费功全) is the actual controller of Chengdu-based Haitian Water Group, founded in 2008 and listed in Shanghai in 2021, which runs water-supply and sewage-treatment concessions and has expanded into waste-to-energy and photovoltaic silver paste. Through Sichuan Haitian Investment and concert parties he controls about 62% of the company. He resigned as chairman but remained a board director.
interesting_fact: Haitian Water, best known for water and wastewater utilities, has diversified into waste-to-energy power and photovoltaic silver paste – an energy-transition angle.
notes: Low profile. Control and 62.03% concert-party stake per https://paper.cnstock.com/html/2026-03/24/content_2191476.htm. Relationship to current chairman Fei Junjie not confirmed in sources.

name: Wei Xuening
current_role: Early private shareholder of Changchun BCHT Biotechnology (百克生物, STAR: 688276); no executive role found
profile: Wei Xuening (魏学宁) became a 10% shareholder of Changchun BCHT Biotechnology – a vaccine maker (varicella, nasal-spray flu, shingles vaccines) controlled by Changchun High & New Tech – in 2008, ahead of its 2021 STAR Market IPO. He has since sold down; by late 2024 his stake fell to about 5%, below the disclosure threshold.
interesting_fact: BCHT makes China's first nasal-spray live attenuated influenza vaccine and a shingles vaccine; its 2021 IPO turned Wei's early stake into a Hurun-list fortune.
notes: Purely a financial shareholder per filings; no biography, interviews or role found. Company IR is the only published channel, but he is not an officer. Product claims about BCHT should be double-checked before use.

name: Shen Jieliang
current_role: Former controlling shareholder of Kuangda Technology Group (旷达科技, SZSE: 002516), Changzhou; ceded control to Zhuzhou state capital (Zhuzhou Qichuang) in 2025-26, retaining ~18.6%
profile: Shen Jieliang (沈介良) is the founder and long-time controlling shareholder of Kuangda Technology, a Changzhou (Wujin), Jiangsu maker of automotive interior fabrics and seating textiles that also built a solar-power business. In 2025 he agreed to sell 28% of Kuangda to Zhuzhou Qichuang for about RMB2.22bn (RMB5.39/share), making Zhuzhou SASAC the actual controller; he keeps roughly 18.6% but waives voting rights.
interesting_fact: His 2025 deal handed control of a private Jiangsu auto-textile maker to the Zhuzhou (Hunan) municipal SASAC for about RMB2.22bn – a notable private-to-state transfer.
notes: Very low media profile. Company is now state-controlled, so Kuangda IR is not a reliable route to him personally. Check completion of share transfer in latest SZSE filings.

name: Peng Jianlin
current_role: Founder, Director and General Manager, Shenzhen Manst Technology (曼恩斯特, SZSE ChiNext: 301325); Tang Xuejiao (唐雪姣) is chair/legal representative
profile: Peng Jianlin (彭建林), a Central South University graduate, founded Shenzhen Manst Technology in 2014. Manst makes precision slot-die coating heads and coating systems used to coat lithium-battery electrodes, supplying CATL, BYD, ATL, LG Energy Solution, CALB and Gotion, and listed on ChiNext in May 2023. The Hurun entry is shared with Tang Xuejiao, Manst's chair.
interesting_fact: Manst is a national 'little giant' specialist whose coating dies sit inside the battery lines of CATL, BYD and LG Energy Solution – an upstream picks-and-shovels play on EV and grid-storage batteries.
notes: Input record mixes names: English name Peng Jianlin but Chinese name 唐雪姣 (Tang Xuejiao, listed as co-holder). Both are tied to Manst; Tang is legal rep per cninfo. Founder/GM claim from https://uk.marketscreener.com/insider/JIAN-LIN-PENG-A3RJP9/. Battery/energy-storage angle fits the podcast.

name: Wang Dayong
current_role: Executive Director and President, Zhejiang Sanhua Intelligent Controls (SZSE: 002050 / HKEX: 2050); director of parent Sanhua Holding Group
profile: Wang Dayong (王大勇, b.1969) is a career Sanhua executive who joined Sanhua Holding Group in 1992 and has been president of listed Sanhua Intelligent Controls since December 2012. Sanhua, based in Xinchang, Zhejiang, is the world's leading maker of refrigeration/HVAC control valves and a major supplier of EV thermal-management parts; it added a Hong Kong listing in 2025. His wealth comes from Sanhua shareholdings.
interesting_fact: Sanhua is a global leader in HVAC control components and EV thermal management – thermal management being increasingly relevant to data-centre liquid cooling.
deep_cut_fact: He started at Sanhua in December 1992 as head of the planning section and secretary to the general manager, then ran manufacturing and the refrigeration-valve division before rising to president – a 30+ year single-company career.
notes: Professional manager rather than founder (Sanhua founded by Zhang Daocai; chairman Zhang Yabo). Still listed as executive director in Aug 2026 HKEX announcement. Thermal management / cooling angle suits a data-centre podcast.
